data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD1: parity-test CI job removed, required-checks.txt entry removed, validate-required-checks.sh confirms alignment

## Implementation
1. Delete .github/workflows/ci-parity.yml
2. Remove the parity section from .github/required-checks.txt (remove: "# ── ci-parity.yml checks ──", "CI Review Parity Test")
3. Run: bash plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/validate-required-checks.sh 2>/dev/null
4. Verify: no parity entry remains

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ci-parity.yml deleted
  Verify: ! test -f .github/workflows/ci-parity.yml
- [ ] required-checks.txt has no parity entry
  Verify: ! grep -qi "parity" .github/required-checks.txt
- [ ] validate-required-checks.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/validate-required-checks.sh 2>/dev/null; test $? -eq 0

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
data.title: Remove ci-parity.yml + parity required-check + validate alignment
